steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Type anatomy: baseline, x-height, ascenders, descenders, cap height — understanding these helps you choose and use type effectively. | Key Fact: Serif fonts have decorative strokes; sans-serif are cleaner and more modern; script fonts suggest elegance or informality. | Key Fact: Typographic hierarchy uses size, weight, colour and position to guide the reader through information in order of importance. | Key Fact: Kerning (space between letters), tracking (overall letter spacing) and leading (line spacing) dramatically affect readability.
